items.label: Total employer burden, class 8742
items.source: Employer FICA + FUTA net rate + Idaho UI new-employer rate 2026 + IIC 2026 WC class 8742 rate, as passed in gate 2026-10-27-f95841; caps not reached within a month

items.label: Total employer burden, class 8810
items.source: Same as above with IIC 2026 WC class 8810 in place of 8742

items.label: Hours a month at 10 hrs/wk
items.source: 10 x 52 / 12, rounded to two decimals

items.label: Hours a month at 15 hrs/wk
Hours a month at 20 hrs/wk
items.source: 20 x 52 / 12, rounded to two decimals

items.label: Monthly wages, 10 hrs/wk at base
items.source: Base rate x 10 x 52 / 12, rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly wages, 15 hrs/wk at base
items.source: Base rate x 15 x 52 / 12

items.label: Monthly wages, 20 hrs/wk at base
items.source: Base rate x 20 x 52 / 12, rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total, 10 hrs/wk, base only
items.source: Monthly wages at 10 hrs plus 8742 burden % on them, burden rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total, 15 hrs/wk, base only
items.source: Monthly wages at 15 hrs plus 8742 burden % on them, burden rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total, 20 hrs/wk, base only
items.source: Monthly wages at 20 hrs plus 8742 burden % on them, burden rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total, 10 hrs/wk, base plus max monthly bonus
items.source: (Monthly wages at 10 hrs + monthly standards bonus maximum) plus 8742 burden % on that sum, burden rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total, 15 hrs/wk, base plus max monthly bonus
items.source: (Monthly wages at 15 hrs + monthly standards bonus maximum) plus 8742 burden % on that sum

items.label: Monthly total, 20 hrs/wk, base plus max monthly bonus
items.source: (Monthly wages at 20 hrs + monthly standards bonus maximum) plus 8742 burden % on that sum

items.label: Extra cost in the month the Phase 1 bonus pays
items.source: Phase 1 gate bonus plus 8742 burden % on it, burden rounded to the cent

items.label: Monthly total, 15 hrs/wk at range low, base only
items.source: Range low rate x 15 x 52 / 12 plus 8742 burden % on it

items.label: Monthly total, 15 hrs/wk at range high, base only
items.source: Range high rate x 15 x 52 / 12 plus 8742 burden % on it

items.label: Monthly total, 15 hrs/wk, base only, class 8810
items.source: Monthly wages at 15 hrs at base plus 8810 burden % on them

items.label: Monthly total, 15 hrs/wk, base plus max monthly bonus, class 8810
items.source: (Monthly wages at 15 hrs + monthly standards bonus maximum) plus 8810 burden % on that sum

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, wages, base only
items.source: Base rate x 15 x 52

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, employer FICA, base only
items.source: Employer FICA rate x annual base wages, to the cent

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, FUTA, base only
items.source: FUTA net rate x the lesser of annual wages and the FUTA wage base

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, Idaho UI, base only
items.source: Idaho UI new-employer rate x the lesser of annual wages and the 2026 Idaho UI wage base

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, workers comp 8742, base only
items.source: WC 8742 rate x annual base wages, to the cent

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, total employer cost, base only
items.source: Annual base wages plus the four burden components above

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, average a month, base only
items.source: Annual total employer cost, base only, / 12

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, gross pay with full incentive
items.source: Annual base wages plus the incentive cap

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, employer FICA, with full incentive
items.source: Employer FICA rate x annual gross pay with full incentive

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, Idaho UI, with full incentive
items.source: Idaho UI rate x annual gross pay with full incentive (under the UI base)

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, workers comp 8742, with full incentive
items.source: WC 8742 rate x annual gross pay with full incentive, to the cent (bonus counted as payroll)

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, total employer cost, with full incentive
items.source: Annual gross pay with full incentive plus FICA, FUTA (first FUTA wage base only), Idaho UI and WC 8742 on it, each to the cent

items.label: Year at 15 hrs/wk, average a month, with full incentive
items.source: Annual total employer cost with full incentive / 12

items.label: Annual saving vs superseded $18 plan, 15 hrs/wk, full incentive
items.source: Annual employer cost at the low-end rate passed in gate 2026-10-27-f95841 minus the annual total employer cost with full incentive above

items.label: Effective hourly pay at 15 hrs/wk with full incentive
items.source: Annual gross pay with full incentive / (15 x 52), to the cent

items.label: Month the FUTA wage base is reached, 15 hrs/wk, base only
items.source: First month in which cumulative monthly base wages at 15 hrs reach the FUTA wage base
